events.title: Dedicated module lines and training academy
events.detail: Montreal tour describes a rotable exchange pool and module-specialized lines. This is AP infrastructure that could support Power, not a dedicated Mod-1 line count.

events.title: $46m Power inventory cash use in H1
events.detail: Cash committed before the anchor contract's scheduled 2027 deliveries; H1 aggregate cannot be split into quarters.

events.title: $1.465bn accepted J&F purchase order
events.detail: Five-year master framework; initial order includes staged production and testing payments. Equipment price can fall by up to 10% for performance shortfall.

events.title: $250m FY2026 Power investment outlook
events.detail: $46m H1 amount is included; implied remaining $204m is guidance arithmetic, not cash already spent.

events.title: Power-tagged Montreal / Rome expansion mapped
events.detail: Slide 7 maps +15,000 sq ft at Montreal and +50,000 sq ft at Rome with Power capability alongside AP / testing. These are shared expansion initiatives, not verified dedicated Mod-1 floor space. Global 3,000-module capacity includes partners and full utilization.

events.title: First customer advance reported received
events.detail: Jereh confirms receipt for the same $1.465bn order. Amount, percentage, receipt date and cash available to FTAI are undisclosed. It says no 2026 earnings impact from this order.

events.title: Jereh reports expansion / rented factory space
events.detail: Existing premises expanded and leased in China and North America; Dubai base progressing. Multiple turbine suppliers and programs share this capacity; no Mod-1 line rate disclosed.

translations.original: 于生产与验收测试环节分阶段支付进度款
translations.translation: Progress payments are made in stages during production and acceptance testing.
translations.check: Consistent with FTAI slide 6 milestone-payment description; percentages undisclosed.

translations.original: 最终款项支付时间不超过设备抵达交付地点后90天
translations.translation: Final payment is due no later than 90 days after equipment reaches the delivery location.
translations.check: Cash deadline is not a revenue-recognition rule or unconditional acceptance date; whitespace normalized.

translations.original: 截止目前，公司已收到该订单约定的首笔预付款
translations.translation: As of the meeting, the company has received the first advance payment specified in this order.
translations.check: Receipt is stated, not merely a promised deposit. Amount and FTAI share are not given.

translations.original: 对2026年度经营业绩无影响
translations.translation: No impact on 2026 operating results from this order is expected.
translations.check: Jereh statement about this order, not a statement of zero FTAI Power spending or all-segment revenue.
